summary: Iteration 4 backend tests complete and ALL GREEN (25/25). Covers: workshop create (server-side check_in_code generation, facilitator self-assign override), duplicate (admin OK, foreign-facilitator 403, new code, slug -copy, status=draft, dates shifted), cancel (workshop status, registration refund metadata with seed_demo → status='manual', workshop_cancelled email queued in db.outbound_emails, second cancel → 400), revenue (admin OK, foreign-facilitator 403, anonymous 401/403), photo upload (paid participant pending, facilitator/admin auto-approved, unpaid registered + stranger 403, >8MB 413, non-image 400), photo list (anonymous gets only approved), cross-workshop pending queue (admin all, facilitator scoped, participant 403), approve/reject moderation, delete rules (uploader can delete own non-approved, cannot delete own approved, admin can delete any), static image serve returns 200 image/jpeg. Frontend smoke: /admin/workshops route is reachable and renders; deeper interactive flows (drawer open, duplicate/cancel/revenue buttons, /admin/photos, WorkshopHub Photos tab) were inconclusive in Playwright because the test session cookie wasn't surviving cross-page navigation reliably — main agent should self-verify those UI flows in the browser.
action_items: Main agent: visually verify /admin/workshops drawer (new + edit modes, facilitator dropdown visible only for admin, slug disabled in edit, check_in_code read-only in edit), duplicate confirm/toast, cancel window.prompt 'CANCEL' flow with refund toast, revenue modal numbers, and /admin/photos approve/reject UI.
Main agent: visually verify WorkshopHub Photos tab — upload with caption, 'Awaiting review' chip on participant pending photo, approved grid, rejection reason display.
critical_code_review_comments: workshops.py: _gen_check_in_code() always overrides client value on create (good — never editable). Facilitator create_workshop forces facilitator_id=self (good).
duplicate_workshop: shifts start/end/early_bird_until by +30 days, generates new check_in_code, slug collision handled via -copy-N. Facilitator-on-other 403 enforced.

cancel_workshop: seed_demo session shortcut to status='manual' is correct (no real Stripe). Email queued per registrant with template='workshop_cancelled' and metadata.workshop_id/registration_id. Idempotency: 400 on already-cancelled. Order of writes (regs first, workshop last) supports retry, but if email/refund partially fails the workshop never flips to cancelled — consider tracking partial failures explicitly for ops alerting.
workshop_revenue: facilitator scope correctly enforced; admin sees any. Math: gross = paid+cancelled amounts; refunded = sum of cancelled refund_amount; net = gross - refunded. Looks correct.

workshop_photos: image processing via Pillow strips EXIF + resizes; thumb generated. 8MB cap enforced AFTER reading body — for very large uploads this still buffers full bytes; consider StreamingFile or chunked read with early abort.
Auth: get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header. Tests must use per-user requests.Session to avoid cross-talk (documented in test_iter4 fixtures).
MINOR: list endpoint /api/workshop-photos with no path matches '@router.get("")' — keep an eye on FastAPI trailing-slash behavior; /api/workshop-photos/ returns 307.

success_rate.frontend: not fully verified (route load OK; interactive flows inconclusive)

The outbound_emails template field is 'template' (not 'template_name') — required for assertions. seed_demo registrations are intentionally routed to refund_status='manual'. Stripe refunds intentionally NOT triggered against real session IDs.
rca of the issue: None — all iteration-4 backend features pass.
